name: noacg
description: Make broadcast graphics for NoaCG Studio and play them out: lower thirds, scoreboards, tickers, bugs, countdowns and full-screen graphics, run live from NoaCG Playout to CasparCG, OBS or vMix, or exported for SPX, H2R or any OGraf renderer. Adds the noacg-graphic skill and the /noacg:graphic command, and runs nothing until a graphic is being made.
